assessment: Value chop is a splitLengths adapter with proved positive take/drop recursion. Size zero and empty input return empty chunks; positive chunks preserve all occurrences and the short final chunk.

Measured chopRun performs separate takeRun and dropRun traversals, charges both plus its own call, and has a strict length termination argument. Its value erases to chop.
Exact source-call result is 2*n + 3*ceil(n/d) + 1 for positive d. The all-size 5*n+1 bound includes d=0; d=1 attains it.
Checked applications cover size zero, empty uninhabited payload type, singleton chunks, overlarge chunk size, short last chunk, and distinguish separate take/drop cost from a fused implementation.
All 59 actual types were read in full. Payload polymorphism, natural costs, ceiling operations and validity premises match the source claims.
